answers.ask: Should this be a modern shopping-mall look, a bright cartoon boutique, or a fashion-studio interior?
answers.answer: Use a bright cartoon boutique look, with clear clothing and body-shape options that are easy to explore.

answers.ask: Is there a runway or judging element, or is it purely free-roam dress-up?
answers.answer: Make it purely free-roam dress-up: players can change their body type and clothes, then walk around, explore, and interact.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D free-roam dress-up map set inside a bright cartoon boutique interior. Arrange clear, easy-to-explore sections for body-shape choices and clothing options, with open walkable space connecting the areas and interactive boutique displays.
agent_notes: Changing body type and clothes is avatar customization, so this is Roleplay & Avatar Sim and the user's own words put it on Dress Up. I substituted settlement-static for the preset's stage-runway because the answers rule out any runway or judging and ask for pure free roam, and settlement-static is exactly a fixed pre-built place where personalization happens through the avatar rather than through property; I kept both preset options and added path-street so there is circulation to explore. I rejected interior-single because walk around and explore reads as more than one enclosed room, and with no user to ask I treated the boutiques as open storefronts, which keeps this on P0 instead of the P3 this genre usually carries. No option covers the body-morph and clothing stations themselves, so they should be placed inside the boutique frontages the layout produces.
